``codec`` for this command only. Same shape as any BLE payload codec
(``Codec[Req, Resp, bytes, bytes]``); it is wrapped in the runtime ``BleChannelCodec``. Omit to use
the transport default.

DiscoverySpec.description:
Optional top-level discovery configuration.

Lists at least one transport-family sub-block. Each present sub-block
drives generation of a corresponding ``make_<family>_scanner()`` and
``default_<family>_matcher()`` in the SDK's ``scanners.py`` module.

Event.description:
Stateless device emission primitive: a subscribe-only stream.

Distinct from an attribute subscribe (which streams changes of a named,
read/writable *value*): an event has no stored state — it is a
fire-and-forget emission (e.g. "button pressed", "recording started"). The
handler declares a single ``payload`` type; the generated facade exposes
``client.<namespace>.<event>.subscribe()`` (async-only).

audience.description: Audiences allowed to subscribe (a subset of the device audience).
audience.title: Audience

ble.description: Per-ble-transport subscribe wiring, keyed by transport id.
ble.title: Ble

handler.description: Dotted path (``module:Class``) to the handler declaring the event's payload type.
handler.title: Handler

http.description: Per-http-transport subscribe wiring, keyed by transport id.
http.title: Http

transports.description: Transport ids this event may ride.
transports.title: Transports

HttpAttributeOp.description:
One HTTP read/write operation for an attribute — a command-shaped block.

Verbs are explicit, never assumed: a non-REST device that *writes* via
``GET`` (e.g. ``GET /setting?option=9``) sets ``method: GET`` with
``query_from_request: true``, exactly like a command.

body_codec.description: How the request body is encoded (``none`` = no body). Currently informational.
body_codec.title: Body Codec

method.description: HTTP verb for this attribute operation.
method.title: Method

query_from_request.description: When true, request fields go on the query string instead of the JSON body.
query_from_request.title: Query From Request

response_codec.description: How the response body is decoded (``none`` = don't decode). Currently informational.
response_codec.title: Response Codec

HttpAttributeOp.title: HttpAttributeOp

HttpAttributeSpec.description: Per-(attribute, http-transport) wiring: the ops this attribute supports here.
HttpAttributeSpec.title: HttpAttributeSpec

HttpAttributeSubscribe.description:
HTTP subscribe wiring for an attribute: native SSE, or explicit opt-in polling.

Polling is never a surprise default — ``mode: poll`` must supply an
``interval``. ``mode: sse`` opens one long-lived event stream instead.

interval.description: Poll interval in seconds; required for ``mode: poll``, forbidden for ``sse``.
interval.title: Interval

mode.description: ``sse`` (one long-lived stream) or ``poll`` (repeated requests on an interval).
mode.title: Mode

HttpAttributeSubscribe.title: HttpAttributeSubscribe

HttpCommandSpec.description: Per-(command, http-transport) wire-format and behavior block.

body_codec.description: How the request body is encoded (``none`` = no body). Currently informational.
body_codec.title: Body Codec

codec.description:
Dotted path (``module:Class``) to a per-command codec that overrides the built-in
``HttpJsonCodec`` for this command only -- use it when one command's wire format differs from the
rest of the transport (a binary or plain-text body). It is constructed like ``HttpJsonCodec``
(method / path / request + response types / ``query_from_request``), so the simplest override
subclasses ``HttpJsonCodec`` and overrides ``decode``. Omit to use the JSON default.
codec.title: Codec

expects_response.description: When false, fire-and-forget: a timeout is swallowed and no response is decoded.
expects_response.title: Expects Response

query_from_request.description: When true, request fields go on the query string instead of the JSON body.
query_from_request.title: Query From Request

response_codec.description: How the response body is decoded (``none`` = don't decode). Currently informational.
response_codec.title: Response Codec

timeout.description: Per-transport timeout override (seconds); falls back to the command-level ``timeout``.
timeout.title: Timeout

HttpCommandSpec.title: HttpCommandSpec

HttpDiscoverySpec.description:
Probe-list configuration for HTTP discovery.

Unlike BLE, HTTP discovery has nothing to listen for — the scanner
must be told which URLs to probe. ``base_urls`` is therefore
required whenever this sub-block is present.

base_urls.description: URLs to probe in parallel; the first whose ``probe_path`` returns 200 wins.
base_urls.title: Base Urls

probe_path.description: Path probed to confirm a device (e.g. ``/.well-known/...``).
probe_path.title: Probe Path

server_header_prefix.description: Optional: require the probe response's ``Server`` header to start with this.
server_header_prefix.title: Server Header Prefix

HttpDiscoverySpec.title: HttpDiscoverySpec

HttpEventSpec.description:
Per-(event, http-transport) subscribe wiring: native SSE, or explicit opt-in polling.

Identical shape to an attribute's subscribe block — an event *is* a
subscribe-only stream — but kept as its own model so the two primitives stay
self-documenting. Polling is never a surprise default: ``mode: poll`` must
supply an ``interval``; ``mode: sse`` opens one long-lived event stream.

interval.description: Poll interval in seconds; required for ``mode: poll``, forbidden for ``sse``.
interval.title: Interval

mode.description: ``sse`` (one long-lived stream) or ``poll`` (repeated requests on an interval).
mode.title: Mode

HttpEventSpec.title: HttpEventSpec

Transport.description:
A wire transport (BLE / HTTP / serial / etc.) plus its codec.

``codec`` is required for every family except HTTP: HTTP commands are
JSON-encoded by the runtime ``HttpJsonCodec``, so an HTTP transport may omit
``codec`` entirely.

The optional ``family`` field tags the transport for cross-validation:
when set, commands riding this transport must supply the matching
per-transport block (``http:`` for ``family=http``, ``ble:`` for
``family=ble``). Loopback / unknown / null transports impose no such
requirement (this preserves the lightweight test-fixture style used
in unit tests).

adapter.description: Dotted path to a custom transport class; omit for the runtime default (HttpTransport / BleTransport).
adapter.title: Adapter

auth.description: Reserved: handshake recipe for ``session_required`` commands on this transport (not yet wired).

channels.description: BLE only: named (write, notify) characteristic pairs; commands pick one via ``ble.<id>.channel``.
channels.title: Channels

codec.description: Dotted path to the wire codec. Required for every family except HTTP (which uses the built-in HttpJsonCodec).
codec.title: Codec

config.description: Free-form runtime config (currently informational; base URL etc. are supplied at runtime).
config.title: Config

family.description: Transport family; drives cross-validation and which per-command block (``http:`` / ``ble:``) is required.
family.title: Family

id.description: Transport id; referenced by ``command.transports`` and the per-command ``http:`` / ``ble:`` blocks.
id.title: Id

Transport.title: Transport

TransportAuth.description: Optional per-transport handshake recipe for session-required commands.

handler.description: Dotted path (``module:Class``) to the handshake handler run before ``session_required`` commands.
handler.title: Handler
